statement: An employer must register with HMRC before the first payday to obtain an employer PAYE reference number, and cannot register more than 2 months before starting to pay people.
caveat: This states HMRC's registration guidance; whether PAYE must be operated for a given worker depends on pay levels, benefits, and other employments. Check HMRC's current guidance on who must register and on registration processing times before the first payroll run.
reviewer: Starter editorial review; independent domain expert review pending
